A '''flailer''' was an agricultural harvesting vehicle that was used on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Stassia]]. [[Reye Sedeya]] was almost killed by a flailer, but it miraculously shut itself down before any harm could come to the young man. Sedeya's good luck was the result of his latent [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitivity]].
